system.description: Normally, it’s not in the Stormlanders’ nature to go berserk, as their battle technique and prowess often involve more style than raw power, but those who worship Ogon can evoke an overwhelming influence that causes them to fly into a rage in particularly hard battles. This effect can be so overpowering that their figures distort, their bodies spasms, their skin begins to bubble, their muscles expand, their veins bulge, and their face twists into a horrific grimace. This battle craze, however, is very demanding on their system and once the duration ends, the mopor will collapse exhausted to the ground for an amount of time equal to half of what was spent berserk. The mopor’s body also needs to be cooled down from its boiling state following the battle craze; otherwise she will suffer damage from the extreme temperature. As soon as the duration ends, the mopor will receive 1 point of damage per action round for 2 rounds (armor will not protect) unless sufficiently cooled. Simply lying down in water (or being throwninto it) is enough to prevent this damage. ✦ Effects of Madness: ✦ The mopor grows 1 m taller and gains 60 kg in muscle (calculated as 1.5 times the size of a normal human) ✦ The mopor receives their own fear factor of 1d10 (OR 10) ✦ +10 Body Points (withdraw damage from this bonus before normal Body Points are affected) ✦ +4 in damage with melee weapons or thrown weapons ✦ +2 on SV of all attacks ✦ The mopor is unable to parry or evade attacks ✦ The mopor ignores all effects from fear ✦ The mopor can continue to fight for 1d3 action rounds after dying
system.summary: Plunges the mopor into a frenzy that makes her more dangerous in combat.
